scope: Read-only operational capability inspection; only control audit/documentation persistence
source: Actual callable ALL_TOOLS operation declarations plus harmless GitHub account/repository reads

capability.requiredCommitParent: exactly expected main head; no additional parents
capability.publication: One final ref movement publishes one commit containing all validated files; unattached Git objects are non-authoritative.
capability.atomicityEvidence: Exposed connector contract rejects mismatched expected_sha; single-parent force=false protects against concurrent append by non-fast-forward rejection.
capability.verificationLevel: Operation contract plus read-only account/access verification; no live write/race probe or backend implementation inspection.

create.basis: Declared path must not already exist; no replacement blob SHA is supplied.

update.basis: Declared current file blob SHA through GitHub Contents API.

decision.rationale: The exposed guarded update_ref plus blob/tree/single-parent commit operations provide the connector-equivalent Git-data publication path. No unguarded or sequential lease fallback is authorized. A future adapter must enforce all control_persistence validation and readback requirements; adapter absence is not claimed resolved.

schedule.notificationBehavior: No schedule update issued; all settings preserved

ci.reason: Audit/documentation commit triggers existing read-only cloud control CI

limitations: Read-only audit cannot establish hidden connector implementation or live write permissions/protection success.
No production persistence adapter or live CAS transaction was installed/exercised.
Guarded Contents writes lack branch-head preconditions and cannot by themselves satisfy multi-file atomic persistence.
